sn3.20:1.1: Atha kho rājā Pasenadi-kosalo divādivassa yena Bhagavā ten-upasaṅkami || upasaṅkamitvā Bhagavantam abhivādetvā ekam antaṃ nisīdi || || Ekam antaṃ nisinnaṃ kho rājānaṃ Pasenadi-kosalam Bhagavā etad avoca ||
sn3.20:1.2: handa kuto nu tvaṃ mahārāja āgacchasi divādivassā ti || || 2.
sn3.20:2.2: tam aham aputtakaṃ sāpateyyaṃ rājantepuram atiharitvā āgacchāmi ||
sn3.20:2.3: sataṃ bhante satasahassāni hiraññassa || ko pana vādo rūpiyassa || ||
sn3.20:2.4: Tassa kho pana bhante seṭṭhissa gahapatissa evarūpo bhattabhogo ahosi
sn3.20:3.1: Evam etaṃ mahārāja evam etam mahārāja ||
sn3.20:3.2: bhūtapubbaṃ so mahārāja seṭṭhi gahapati Taggarasikkhiṃ nāma paccekabuddhaṃ piṇḍapātena paṭipādesi
sn3.20:3.3: detha samaṇassa piṇḍan ti vatvā uṭṭhāyāsanā pakkāmi
sn3.20:3.4: datvā ca pana pacchā vippaṭisārī ahosi ||
sn3.20:3.5: varaṃ etaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ dāsā vā kammakarā vā bhuñjeyyun ti ||
sn3.20:3.6: bhātu ca pana ekaputtaṃ sāpateyyassa kāraṇā jīvitā voropesi || || 4.
sn3.20:4.1: Yaṃ kho so mahārāja seṭṭhi-gahapati Tagarasikhim paccekabuddham piṇḍapātena paṭipādesi || tassa kammassa vipākena sattakhattum sugatiṃ saggaṃ lokam uppajji ||
sn3.20:4.2: tass-eva kammassa vipākāvasesena imissā yeva Sāvatthiyā sattakkhattuṃ seṭṭhittam kāresi || || 5.
sn3.20:4.3: Yaṃ kho so mahārāja seṭṭhi gahapati datvā pacchā vippaṭisārī ahosi ||
sn3.20:4.4: varam etaṃ piṇḍapātaṃ dāsā vā kammakarā vā bhuñjeyyun ti || tassa kammassa vipākena nāssuḷārāya bhatta-bogāya cittaṃ namati || nāssuḷārāya vatthabhogāya cittaṃ namati || nāssuḷārāya yāna-bhogāya cittaṃ namati || nāss-uḷārāṇaṃ pañcannaṃ kāma-gunānaṃ bhogāya cittaṃ namati || 6.
sn3.20:4.5: Yaṃ kho so mahārāja seṭṭhi gahapati bhātuca pana ekaputtakaṃ sāpateyyassa kāraṇā jīvitā voropesi || tassa kammassa vipākena bahūni vassāni bahūni vassa-satāni bahūni vassa-sahassāni bahūni vassa-sata-sahassāni niraye paccittha ||
sn3.20:4.6: tass-eva kammassa vipākāvasesena idam sattamam aputtakaṃ sāpateyyaṃ rāja-kosam paveseti ||
sn3.20:4.7: tassa kho pana mahārāja seṭṭhissa gahapatissa purāṇaṃ ca puññaṃ parikkhīṇaṃ navañ ca puññaṃ anupacitaṃ || ||
sn3.20:4.8: Ajja pana mahārāja seṭṭhi gahapati Mahāroruva-niraye paccatīti || || 7. Evaṃ bhante seṭṭhi gahapati Mahāroruvaṃ nirayam uppanno ti || || 8. Evam mahārāja seṭṭhi gahapati Mahāroruve niraye uppanno
sn3.20:5.2: pariggahaṃ vā pi yad atthi kiñci ||
